product_metadata.title: Trudeau Meat Forks with Silicone Handles Fondue Set, Standard, Multicolored
features: Set of 6 colorful fondue forks by Trudeau
Forks are made of high quality stainless steel; won't rust or tarnish
Silicone handles are colorful and provide a sure grip and remain cool to the touch
Each fork has a different colored handle to easily identify which fork is yours
Stylish gift box makes this set ideal for gift-giving
description: Fondue is a fun way to try scrumptious new food combinations. Celebrate with friends and enjoy your fondue creations with the Trudeau silicone met fondue forks. Made of premium stainless steel, the length of the forks is ideal to keep hands away from hot oil and sauces, while the forked tips grip meat and other proteins to prevent them from dropping. The silicone handles provide a cool touch as well as a sure-grip, while the bright, cheerful colors make identifying your fork easy. The set of 6 forks makes it easy to share your meal with several friends, and the gift box it comes in makes for easy gift-giving. From Trudeau, a trusted brand and global leader in innovative kitchen product design for over 125 years.
